metadata.name: PhoenixCloseAndWithdraw
metadata.description: Rise CPI example program that closes Phoenix Eternal positions and withdraws free collateral through Phoenix and Ember

docs: Manual Anchor-compatible IDL for the Pinocchio PhoenixCloseAndWithdraw example program.
Instruction data uses an 8-byte Anchor-style discriminator followed by Borsh-serialized params.

The Phoenix GlobalTraderIndex and ActiveTraderBuffer account groups are dynamic. Each instruction keeps these account groups at the end of the account list. The exact counts are carried in the instruction params.

Fixed Phoenix Eternal mainnet program accounts use the Anchor IDL account address field where the account has a canonical mainnet pubkey. Exchange-state and market-specific accounts are supplied from exchange metadata or the Phoenix global configuration.

The demo validates the supplied program ids, Ember state/vault PDAs, Ember input and output mints, and Phoenix global-configuration accounts before CPI. Phoenix Eternal and Ember validate those invariants again inside their CPI handlers.

instructions.name: ClosePositionAndWithdraw
docs: Reads withdrawable collateral with Hawkeye, places a reduce-only Phoenix Eternal market order, reads withdrawable collateral again, then withdraws through Phoenix and Ember.
Use withdrawMode to withdraw all free collateral after the order or only the collateral delta freed by this order.

instructions.name: ClosePositionAndWithdrawWithBuilders
docs: Same flow as ClosePositionAndWithdraw, but wraps the Phoenix market order CPI in a Flight proxy instruction so a registered builder can collect builder fees.
The five Flight accounts are fixed accounts immediately before the dynamic Phoenix account tail.

types.name: ClosePositionAndWithdrawParams

types.name: WithdrawAllCollateralParams
docs: Borsh payload for withdraw_all_collateral.

types.name: WithdrawMode
docs: Controls how much collateral is withdrawn after the close order.

types.name: Side
docs: Phoenix market-order side. Use Ask to reduce a long position and Bid to reduce a short position.

docs: Phoenix self-trade policy passed through to the reduce-only market order.
